integrity: Analytical proof reconstructed, self-contained verifier replayed; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two priority levels, complete conflict, deterministic index tie breaking and common strictly positive linear price are covered.
No characterization of mixed equilibria, heterogeneous pricing or other conflict graphs.
Finite tests are corroboration, not exhaustive proof for all n.
Originality remains subject to unindexed or differently formulated literature.
title: Exact price resonances for binary priority games on complete conflict graphs
